content_of_post_to_answer: Psychology of Everyday Life: Why do my memories seem distant and dreamlike?
answer: Memories feeling distant and dreamlike may happen because remembering is not like replaying a recording; it is a reconstruction. Over time, the brain often keeps the emotional meaning and general pattern while losing the vivid sensory details that made an event feel "real." This can make childhood or past experiences feel like they happened to someone else. A strange truth about memory is that distance does not always mean forgetting; sometimes it means the mind has converted an experience from a lived moment into part of your personal story.
